summary: Initiated Phase P8: Advanced Modalities, Radar (SAR) & Hyperspectral Gating
details: Created PLAN-0009. Developing advanced modality architecture: atyaf_core/modalities/ with SAR (Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR, NISAR) specifications and gating (never route SAR through optical equations), Hyperspectral (EnMAP, PRISMA, EMIT) cube/wavelength validation, SAM/MNF, Sentinel-1 parser, and comprehensive gating tests.
